hints.title: Parity Partitioning
hints.text: Digits can only be swapped with other digits of the same parity (even with even, odd with odd).

hints.title: Greedy Highest Digit Placement
hints.text: To make the overall number as large as possible, place the largest available digit of the same parity in the earliest positions.

hints.title: Separate Sorted Digit Queues
hints.text: Collect even and odd digits separately and sort them in descending order.

hints.title: Reconstruction via Parity Selection

variables: d: number of digits in num (at most 10)
complexity.notes: Sorting at most 10 digits takes negligible constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all valid permutations of swaps is unnecessary when greedy sorting is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Arrays of digits take O(d) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate separates digits by parity and reconstructs greedily.
